items.source: Annotation-Based Handlers: Client uses @McpSampling, @McpLogging, and @McpProgress annotations
items.translation: 基于注解的处理器：客户端使用 @McpSampling、@McpLogging 和 @McpProgress 注解。

items.source: Multi-Model Sampling: Server requests content from multiple LLM providers using model hints
items.translation: 多模型采样：服务器使用模型提示从多个大语言模型提供商处请求内容

items.source: Stateless HTTP Transport: Uses the streamable protocol for communication
items.translation: 无状态 HTTP 传输：使用流式协议进行通信

items.source: Creative Content Generation: Generates poems about weather data from different models
items.translation: 创意内容生成：生成关于不同模型天气数据的诗歌

items.source: Unified Response Handling: Combines responses from multiple providers into a single result
items.translation: 统一响应处理：将多个提供商的响应合并为单个结果

items.source: This example uses McpSyncServerExchange directly for fine-grained control over the low-level MCP API. For simpler cases, use McpSyncRequestContext which provides a higher-level, more convenient interface (e.g., context.sampleEnabled(), context.sample(…​), context.info(…​)).
items.translation: 本示例直接使用 McpSyncServerExchange 以实现对底层 MCP API 的细粒度控制。对于更简单的场景，请使用 McpSyncRequestContext，它提供了更高级、更便捷的接口（例如 context.sampleEnabled()、context.sample(…​)、context.info(…​)）。
